flags.reasoning: The prior period included the full regulatory-required disclosure: the definition of disclosure controls and procedures, the CEO/CFO effectiveness conclusion ('were effective as of March 31, 2025'), and the statement that no changes in internal control over financial reporting occurred during the quarter. The current period only states that an evaluation was carried out as of June 30, 2025, but omits the effectiveness conclusion and the changes-in-ICFR statement. These are SEC-required disclosures under Item 4 of Form 10-Q; their absence is a red flag.

overall.summary: FLS shows genuine disclosure degradation in its Q2 2025 10-Q compared to Q1, particularly around critical accounting policies, disclosure controls effectiveness conclusions, and foreign currency quantitative detail — all of which were present in the prior quarter and appear to have been stripped. The peer comparison flags are mostly inverted (FLS is actually more detailed than peers on operational and supply chain topics), though FLS's regulatory/legal disclosure on the OBBBA is notably thin versus peers.
